title: Jab
text: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.

title: Guard
text: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].

title: Rev Up
text: [gold]Rev[/gold].

title: Haymaker
text: [gold]Unleash[/gold] — deal damage equal to your [gold]Charge[/gold].

title: Warm Engine
text: [gold]Rev[/gold]. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].

title: Wind-Up
text: [gold]Rev[/gold].

title: Raptor Boost
text: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. [gold]Rev[/gold].

title: Guard Up
text: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. If your [gold]Charge[/gold] is above base, gain {HighBlock:diff()} instead.

title: One-Two
text: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice. [gold]Combo 3[/gold]: draw 1.

title: Dash Attack
text: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. [gold]Combo 3[/gold]: deal {ComboDamage:diff()} instead.

title: Shoulder Check
text: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. [gold]Sweetspot[/gold] — enemy intends to Attack: apply {Weak:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].

title: Falcon Dive
text: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If Fatal, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and [gold]Rev[/gold].

title: Sidestep
text: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].

title: Show Me Your Moves
text: Apply {Weak:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold]. Draw {Cards:diff()} card.

title: Full Throttle
text: [gold]Rev[/gold] twice.

title: Ignition
text: [gold]Rev[/gold].

title: Redline
text: [gold]Rev[/gold]. If your [gold]Charge[/gold] is {Threshold:diff()} or more, [gold]Rev[/gold] again.

title: Slipstream
text: Whenever you play your {Threshold:diff()}th card in a turn, [gold]Rev[/gold].

title: Perfect Shield
text: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. If you block ALL attack damage this turn, [gold]Rev[/gold] at end of turn.

title: Pressure
text: Deal damage equal to half your [gold]Charge[/gold]. Doesn't reset.

title: Stored Power
text: Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to half your [gold]Charge[/gold].

title: Falcon Kick
text: [gold]Unleash[/gold] — deal damage equal to your [gold]Charge[/gold] to ALL enemies.

title: Clean KO
text: Deal damage equal to your [gold]Charge[/gold]. If this kills the enemy, don't reset.

title: Knee of Justice
text: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. [gold]Sweetspot[/gold] — enemy intends to Attack: deal {SweetDamage:diff()} instead.

title: Grab
text: The target loses ALL [gold]Block[/gold], then deal {Damage:diff()} damage.

title: Spot Dodge
text: The next time an enemy attacks you this turn, it misses entirely.

title: YES!
text: If you [gold]Unleashed[/gold] this turn: gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} cards.

title: Warm-Up Lap
text: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. [gold]Combo 4[/gold]: gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.

title: FALCON PUNCH
text: [gold]Unleash[/gold] — deal damage equal to DOUBLE your [gold]Charge[/gold]. [gold]Follow-Through[/gold] (excess damage hits another enemy).

title: Blue Falcon
text: Deal damage equal to your [gold]Charge[/gold] to ALL enemies. This doesn't reset your [gold]Charge[/gold].

title: G-Diffuser
text: At the start of your turn, [gold]Rev[/gold].

title: Super Armor
text: Your [gold]Charge[/gold] can no longer be halved.

title: Champion's Fist
text: Increase your base [gold]Charge[/gold] by {Base:diff()}.

title: Muscle Memory
text: [gold]Rev[/gold] once, plus once more for each time you've [gold]Unleashed[/gold] this combat.

title: Highlight Reel
text: Whenever you [gold]Unleash[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} cards.

title: Heat Haze
text: Whenever you [gold]Rev[/gold], deal {Haze:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.

title: Hard Read
text: [gold]Sweetspot[/gold] — if the enemy intends to Attack: it is [gold]Stunned[/gold]. Otherwise, draw 1 card.

title: Photo Finish
text: Deal damage equal to your [gold]Charge[/gold]. [gold]Sweetspot[/gold] — this kills the last enemy: heal {Heal:diff()} HP and gain {Gold:diff()} Gold.
